# list

List available environments

## Usage

```
ppds env list [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--filter` | `-fl` | `string` |  | Filter environments by name, URL, or ID (case-insensitive) |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
